limits: Two real NOAA ENC cells with two supplied updates each are a research fixture set, not full IHO or all-producer/edition coverage.
Sounding Z retains encoded sign/units/datum; MLLW/MHW is not automatically model sea level.
Frozen data retrieval date does not assert charts are currently suitable for navigation.
Derived malicious or metadata-altered test inputs are created in memory, separately labelled, and not represented as original NOAA files.

native_limitations.observed: Native base DSID_UPDN1 with supplied.002 leaves APPLY atUPDN1; explicit driver-limitation rejection required, not invalid-source-chain label. Derived test fixture is a declaration/admission probe, not an original NOAA reissue.
native_limitations.standard: IHO ENC product specification5.7/Table5.1 explicitly permits reissue baseUPDN>0 followed byUPDN+1.
native_limitations.unsupported_workaround: No fabricated missing updates or rewritten native headers.
